summary: Assess agricultural sourcing, post-harvest loss and traceability with practical exercises. Explore the five-day agribusiness training course.
lede: Sustainable agricultural supply chain management coordinates inputs, production, aggregation, storage, processing and distribution from farm to market. For agricultural procurement staff, supply chain coordinators and sustainability officers, this course covers mapping seasonal commodity flows, assessing farm and post-harvest impacts, and setting supplier criteria. It also introduces practical loss-reduction measures, lot-traceability workflows and reporting based on available evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who make or support decisions across agricultural production, commodity purchasing and farm-to-market operations. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical ways to assess impacts, engage suppliers and document improvement priorities.
modules: FAO Food Loss and Handling Decisions
prerequisites: No specialist sustainability or emissions-accounting knowledge is assumed. Familiarity with at least one agricultural activity, such as sourcing, production, aggregation, storage, processing or distribution, will help you apply the exercises. Coding or programming is not required.
